ev_0005.summary: Consolidated model: large circle circle_01 (O=(202.29,198.97), r=157.2) passes through A, B, C and M. O is the circumcentre of ABC (distances from O: A 157.1, B 157.5, C 156.8 px; O lies on the circle, within about 1 px). Chord CB (seg_02, solid) lies at y=278. P=(202,278) lies on CB and is the foot of the perpendicular from O to CB (OP is vertical, CB horizontal), and is also approximately the midpoint of CB (CB midpoint x=202.7 vs P x=202.0). Small circle circle_02 (centre point_06=(202.15,285.54), r=70.79) is internally tangent to circle_01 at M: centre distance 86.57 vs R-r=86.41 (0.16 px gap). M lies at the bottom of circle_01, on the vertical line x~202 through O, P and the small centre. P is NOT the small circle's centre: P is 7.5 px above point_06 and lies inside circle_02 as a chord point of CB, which cuts circle_02 (its distance to the centre is 7.5 < r=70.8). Dashed OC and OB (seg_04, seg_05) are confirmed by collinear dash chains. The vertical O-P-M is dashed per supervisor

Objects: large circle center (202.29,198.97) r=157.2 passing through A, B, C, M; small circle center (202.15,285.54) r=70.79, internally tangent to the large circle at M (bottom). Segments: solid chords AC, AB, CB (horizontal at y=278); dashed segments OC and OB (CV dashed lines line_04, line_05); dashed vertical segment O-P-M (line_06 is only a 22px fragment around P, interrupted by the P dot, so treat the vertical as dashed from O through P to M). Point_06 at (202.15,285.54) is the small circle's centre, unlabeled; it is not P. Report the relations (O is the circumcentre of ABC, M lies on the vertical line through O, small circle tangent to large circle at M, CB is a chord) and any conflicts, e.g. whether P is the small circle centre or the foot on CB.
